motion_system: Keep the plate still at rest. On deliberate hover or tap, shift only the selected recessed edge slightly to expose its real source media; no looping zoom, camera movement or moving vegetation. Disable displacement for reduced motion.
color_drift: None. Preserve sandy stone, cool glazing, pale sky and restrained green-mauve planting; confine the proposed jewel-green accent to the terrazzo reveal.
glow_behavior: No emitted glow. Use only subdued glass reflections and daylight on worn stone lips.
